Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City DILG OPINION No. co www.di'gAOV.ph MAY 15 2025 ATTY. REENA VIVIENNE C. PINEDA Commissioner-in-Charge Offce of the Chairperson and CEO National Youth Commission 3rd Fir. West Insula Building, 135 West Avenue cor. EDSA Brgy. Bungad, Quezon City Dear Atty. Pineda: s. 204 This has reference to your letter dated 18 March 2025 seeking legal opinion on whether the seat of representatives in the Local Youth Development Council (LYDC) is conferred upon the organization or the individual representative. Upon careful examination, it is our considered legal opinion that LY DC membership is conferred upon the organization, not the individual representative. The law recognizes youth organizations and youth-serving organizations as the primary members of the LYDC, thereby affirming that the seat belongs to the organization. Consequently, the organization retains the discretion to designate, replace, or substitute its representative as necessary, provided that the newly designated individual meets the qualifications set forth under the law. We refer to Section 23 of R.A. No. 10742 (the "Sangguniang Kabataan Reform Act of 2015") was not repeaied by R.A. No. 11768. Notabiy, this provision reads: CHAPTER Ill THE LOCAL YOUTH DEVELOPMENT COUNCIL (LYDC) SECTION 23. Creation. — To ensure wide and multi-sectoral youth participation in local governance, there shall be in every province, city and municipality a Local Youth Development Council (LYDC) "which shall be called, Provincial Youth Development Council, City Youth Development Council and Municipal Youth Development Council, respectively. The LYDC shall be composed of representatives of youth and youth-serving organizations in the provincial, city, and municipal level. The LYDC shall assist the planning and execution of projects and programs of the Sangguniang Kabataan, and the Pederasyons in all levels. R.A. No. 11768 merely inserted a new Section 231 and renumbered the succeeding 1 Section 9. Insert a new Section 23 of Republic Act No. 10742 to read as follows, and renumber the "Maüno, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

sections. Thus, Section 23 as stated under R.A. No. 10742 is still good law. Based on the foregoing, LYDC membership is an institutional representation rather than a personal appointment or election. Since the law does not provide a fixed tenure for individual representatives, organizations may change their designated representatives as necessary, subject to compliance with applicable accreditation and regulatory requirements. While the qualifications stated under Section 25(h) of the Implementing Rules and Regulations of R.A. No. 10742 are personal in nature, these do not conflict with the fact our interpretation that LYDC membership is conferred upon the organization. In other words, LYDC membership is bestowed upon the organizations while these organizations' representative to the LYDC must possess the qualifications stated under Section 25(h). Lastly, the foregoing interpretation is practical and obviates scenarios wherein a representative no longer enjoys the trust and confidence of the organization he is representing but cannot be removed from the LYDC for the sole reason that his term has yet to expire. We trust that this legal opinion sufficiently addresses your inquiry. Very truiy yours. BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: ATTY. ROMEO P. BENITEZ Undersecretary for External, Legal and Legislative Affairs succeeding sections accordingly: "Section 23. Membership in the National Youth Commission. - The presidents of tie Panlalawigang Pederasyon ng mga Sangguniang Kabataan and the presidents of the Panlungsod na Pederasyon ng mga Sangguniang Kabataan of highly urbanized cities and independent component cities shall elect among themselves, a representative who shall sit as an ex officio member of the National Youth Commission, consistent With Section 5 Of Republic Act No. 8044, otherwise known as the "Youth in Nation-Building Act"
